name: subtitles-count-a6e366d6-linux-arm64
reason: Screen of reading SCTE 20 caption bits through triergon-bitstream, on a c8g.xlarge (Linux AArch64): same-code against main at 75bbc6d5 for the subtitle, subtitle capsule and playback workers (only the caption extraction functions differ), and the instruction count of every case of subtitle-cc, -pgs, -dvb, -dvd and -teletext at both revisions, 50 operations on CPU 1. Measured at 9adb13de, whose code is that of a6e366d6. A zstd-compressed tar of the deterministic pack.
